scientific_integrity.basis: Self-contained constructive graph-theoretic proof supplemented by finite independent shortest-path checks.
scientific_integrity.unproved: No theorem for t<6s; no sharpness assertion for the sufficient cutoff; no independent scientific audit.

scientific_limitations: Proved only for integers s>=3 and t>=6s. The cutoff is sufficient rather than necessary; the remaining part of the path-cycle mutual visibility conjecture is not resolved. The finite script is a reproducibility test, not a proof for all parameters.
title: A uniform long-circumference threshold for mutual visibility on cylindrical grids
